messages.author: 3b104dc6686d0c85
messages.subject: Re: help: org.renjin.eval.EvalException: Sorry! write.table not yet implemented!
parts:
Not all GNU R functions are implemented in Renjin. write.table() is one of them and there's an issue open for it which provides a workaround: https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/issues/49

Maarten-Jan
